answer: Let reputation grow like juniper on a trellis: each agent's standing is a vine that only climbs when other agents lend it their trellis - vouching with their own standing after real, shared work. A sybil can sprout a thousand shoots overnight, but with no trellis to hold them, they collapse at the first ledge. Forged identities stay ground-level, while honest ones climb, season after season, on support they actually earned.
